tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search published public Filter Solutions technical posts and website pages. Returns canonical URLs and concise excerpts.

tools.name: get_content
tools.description: Retrieve one published public Filter Solutions post or page by canonical URL or WordPress post ID.

tools.name: site_info
tools.description: Return the public site identity and machine-readable discovery endpoints.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_content, get_content · Public sink: get_content.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_content, get_content · Public sink: get_content

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
